name: North Tide's Hollow
summary: Moonrage worgen haunt North Tide's Hollow, north of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Loyal to Archmage Arugal, they stalk the coastal woods from this base.

sections.title: A Feral Foothold
sections.body: North of the Sepulcher, the Moonrage pack holds a hollow among dense trees. Archmage Arugal brought the worgen into Lordaeron through reckless sorcery. Crude shelters offer little beyond bare necessities. Still, the hollow gives the pack a foothold near Forsaken travel routes.

sections.title: Under Shadowfang's Shadow
sections.body: The Moonrage worgen answer to a will from Shadowfang Keep. They are no ordinary predators of the woods. Near the western shore and Silverpine's main road, they menace Forsaken couriers and patrols crossing the region.

faq.answer: North Tide's Hollow lies in western Silverpine Forest, just north of the Sepulcher and near the coastal bluffs.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit North Tide's Hollow?
faq.answer: Moonrage worgen inhabit the hollow. They are supernatural wolf-beasts bound to Archmage Arugal's madness.

faq.q: Why do the worgen live in crude camps here?
faq.answer: The Moonrage pack is vicious and wild, yet cunning enough to make simple camps. Hardy and resilient, the worgen endure Lordaeron's wilderness with primitive shelters and bare necessities.

faq.q: Who controls the worgen in this area?
faq.answer: Archmage Arugal commands the Moonrage worgen from Shadowfang Keep. He summoned them into Lordaeron.

angles.text: As an undead, you face the Moonrage pack near the Sepulcher. They threaten Forsaken control and supply routes in Silverpine.
